description: Controller class for managing CalendarAccount operations in SuiteCRM, including actions for editing, saving, testing connections, retrieving provider auth methods, and syncing calendar accounts. Contains methods for handling API exceptions and sending JSON responses.

classes.name: CalendarAccountController
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD, testing, and synchronization actions for CalendarAccount entities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Sets view to 'edit' and initializes the 'type' parameter for the CalendarAccount bean.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Saves the CalendarAccount bean, handles exceptions, and redirects on error.

methods.name: action_getProviderAuthMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method for a specified calendar provider and returns it as JSON.

methods.name: action_testConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to a calendar provider, returns detailed results including duplicates and status.

methods.name: action_syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Triggers manual synchronization of a calendar account and returns confirmation.

methods.name: setupCalendarAccountFromRequest
methods.description: Creates or loads a CalendarAccount from request parameters, including OAuth and API credentials.

methods.name: handleApiException
methods.description: Handles exceptions, maps them to HTTP codes and error responses, and logs errors.

methods.name: sendJsonResponse
methods.description: Outputs a JSON response with proper headers and error handling.
